title: Moro Rock Trail
map_label: A 3D walk up the stairs of Moro Rock to the summit in Sequoia National Park.

stops.title: Moro Rock Trailhead
stops.alt: The start of the Moro Rock trail at the base of the granite dome.
stops.text: The route starts at the Moro Rock parking area. About 350 stairs climb the granite dome.

stops.title: Moro Rock Summit
stops.alt: The view from the top of Moro Rock over the Sierra foothills.
stops.text: You have reached the summit of Moro Rock, about 6,300 feet up, with views of the Great Western Divide.
